name: BL-042 criteria, addendum 1: a quality score for each base, and two ranking shapes swapped
adds_to: bl042_criteria.json - unchanged except where this file says
rule: Committed before any forward return is computed (Phases 4-6 have not run). Never edited after results are seen: a change is a new file that names this one as superseded, with the reason.
reason: Owner's decisions, 2026-10-07. (1) Phase 2b (ranks only) showed that at detection only 1-2% of bases sit in the pool's top 20; most sit around pool rank 50-150. filter_20 and bonus_5 cannot move such a stock into the top 10 the baseline buys, so they test nothing; the owner chose to swap them for filter_100 and bonus_25, keeping 7 shapes and 21 trials. (2) The owner asked for each base to be graded by how well it is formed, from textbook rules fixed before any return is read.

quality.plain: Each detection gets a 0-1 grade: the mean of its components, each clipped to [0, 1]. It is computed from the detection's own geometry only - never from anything after the detection week.

tight_range.volume_dry_up: (1 - volume_10d_vs_50d) / 0.5 (0.5x or less of the 50-day average = 1; missing = 0.5)

flag.quiet: (1 - flag_vs_pole_volume) / 0.6 (0.4x of the pole's volume or less = 1)

cup_handle.depth_sweet_spot: 1 for depth 0.15-0.30, falling linearly to 0 at 0.12 and at 0.35

uses.blend: the blend shapes use pattern_score = state score x quality (a perfect base outranks a sloppy one in the same state)
uses.filter_and_bonus: unchanged: a detection is state score >= 0.5, whatever its quality
uses.event_study: judged test unchanged (any detection). Reported only, not judged: the same 13-week statistic for each quality third, cut points from the development window's detections.
